design.name: 夔·残破雷鼓
design.brief: The broken thunder drum lying on the prayer-flag summit while Kui is absent (a level prop; Kui grows out of it in storms).
design.turnaround_lead: the broken thunder drum from Kui's chest, as a big fallen drum on its own
design.turnaround_pose: , lying on its side, tilted: a big round drum about 2.2 m across, the same tattered pale drum skin painted with red thunder spirals as on Kui's chest, torn open on one side, a cracked frame of curved pale beast ribs lashed with old leather straps and copper bands, a faint magenta glow inside the tear painted as an opaque colour (no halo); no creature, no arms, no legs, no head
design.turnaround_digits: The whole drum, the torn skin and every rib of the frame fully inside the frame; in the side views the round profile must be clearly readable.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
